props.name: name
props.description: The name the ISO value submits and `Form` errors arrive under. Inside `Form`, the ISO text reaches `onFormSubmit` and native `FormData` under it. props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with this runtime's Temporal value once the segments form a new one, or with `null` when every segment is cleared. Its kind is typed from `value` or `defaultValue`, and without either from `granularity` and `timeZone`, as the field resolves it: no granularity or `"day"` gives a `PlainDate`, a time granularity a `PlainDateTime`, and a time granularity with `timeZone` a `ZonedDateTime`. It takes no type argument. Typing fills a segment and moves on when it is full: `10052026` in en-US, `05102026` in nb-NO. Arrow Up and Down step a segment and wrap, Page Up and Page Down step by 5 years, 2 months, 7 days, 2 hours or 15 minutes, Home and End go to its ends, and Backspace removes a digit. Those keys with Ctrl, Cmd or Alt are left to the browser. An arrow key on an empty segment starts from today, read when the user presses it. The value commits once every segment is filled; a date the segments cannot form, such as February 30, commits on blur as the month's last day. On a phone the segments open the numeric keyboard with a Next key.

props.name: shouldForceLeadingZeros
props.description: Pads days, months and hours with a leading zero whatever the locale writes. React Aria's DateField defaults to the locale's padding.

props.name: size
props.description: The field box's control size: `"default"` the `md` one, `"sm"` the `sm` one.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The zone an empty field takes. React Aria reads the zone from a value, so a field that starts empty needs `timeZone` with a time `granularity` to emit `ZonedDateTime`s, in this zone. The field names the zone as it is today, read once the field has mounted, and emptying the field keeps its kind and zone. Stepping the hour moves through real hours: on a night the clocks go back the repeated hour comes twice, and on a night they go forward the missing hour never comes.

props.name: value
props.description: The value, when the parent owns it: a `Temporal.PlainDate`, `PlainDateTime` or `ZonedDateTime` from any implementation. Its kind picks the segments: a `PlainDate` edits the date, the other two the date and time. A server component cannot pass one, since it reaches the client as ISO text, which the field refuses with a `TypeError`: build the value in a client component. `null` empties it. Import `@elmeragroup/fuse/temporal-polyfill` on the server and in the browser for engines without `Temporal`, and type-check with TypeScript 6 and an `esnext` lib, as `/quick-start#temporal` shows.

props.name: children
